title: "02 — community assembly: variance partitioning, ordination, β-NTI"
subtitle: "Figure 2 of the ISME / Microbiome manuscript"
format:
  html:

---

Figure 2 asks whether the Empty Quarter microbiome is structured by
deterministic processes (selection by environment) or by stochastic
ones (dispersal limitation, drift). Panels:

* **A.** Aitchison-PCoA of all samples, coloured by compartment, shape by trip
* **B.** Bray–Curtis-PCoA for comparison
* **C.** PERMANOVA R² per term (site, compartment, trip, habitat)
* **D.** β-NTI distributions per compartment (loaded from the Slurm output)

The β-NTI panel is produced against the FastTree backup tree for a
first-pass result; it will be regenerated once SEPP fragment-insertion
finishes and the caches are updated.

```{python}
#| label: setup
import sys
from pathlib import Path
REPO = Path.cwd().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(REPO / "src"))

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

from eq import CACHE_DIR, FIGURES_DIR
from eq.beta import aitchison_distance, bray_curtis, clr, pcoa, permanova_by_term

plt.rcParams.update({
    "figure.dpi": 120,
    "font.size": 9,
    "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.spines.right": False,
})
```

## Load cache

```{python}
#| label: load
ft = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "feature_table.parquet")
meta = pd.read_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "metadata.parquet")
meta = meta.dropna(subset=["trip", "compartment"]).copy()
meta["trip"] = meta["trip"].astype(int)
meta["site"] = meta["site"].astype(int)
ft = ft[meta.index]
print(f"ASVs × samples: {ft.shape}")
print(meta["compartment"].value_counts())
```

## Compositional transform + distances

```{python}
#| label: distances
print("CLR transform …")
ft_clr = clr(ft)
print("Aitchison distance …")
d_ait = aitchison_distance(ft_clr)
print("Bray–Curtis …")
d_bc = bray_curtis(ft)
d_ait.to_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "distance_aitchison.parquet")
d_bc.to_parquet(CACHE_DIR / "distance_bray.parquet")
print("done")
```

## PCoA

```{python}
#| label: pcoa
pc_ait, var_ait = pcoa(d_ait, n_components=4)
pc_bc,  var_bc  = pcoa(d_bc,  n_components=4)
pc_ait = pc_ait.join(meta[["trip", "compartment", "site"]])
pc_bc  = pc_bc.join(meta[["trip", "compartment", "site"]])
print(f"Aitchison variance explained: PCo1={var_ait[0]:.3f}, PCo2={var_ait[1]:.3f}")
print(f"Bray      variance explained: PCo1={var_bc[0]:.3f}, PCo2={var_bc[1]:.3f}")
```

```{python}
#| label: fig2-ordination
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.5))
palette = {"surface": "#d62728", "deep": "#1f77b4", "rhizosphere": "#2ca02c"}
for ax, coords, var, title in zip(
    axes, [pc_ait, pc_bc], [var_ait, var_bc], ["Aitchison", "Bray–Curtis"]
):
    for comp, grp in coords.groupby("compartment"):
        ax.scatter(grp["PCo1"], grp["PCo2"], s=12, alpha=0.5,
                   label=comp, color=palette[comp])
    ax.set_xlabel(f"PCo1 ({var[0]*100:.1f}%)")
    ax.set_ylabel(f"PCo2 ({var[1]*100:.1f}%)")
    ax.set_title(title)
axes[0].legend(fontsize=8, frameon=False)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig2ab_pcoa.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()
```

## PERMANOVA per term

```{python}
#| label: permanova
terms = ["site", "compartment", "trip"]
perm_ait = permanova_by_term(d_ait, meta, terms, n_perm=999).assign(metric="aitchison")
perm_bc  = permanova_by_term(d_bc,  meta, terms, n_perm=999).assign(metric="bray")
perm = pd.concat([perm_ait, perm_bc], ignore_index=True)
perm.to_csv(CACHE_DIR / "permanova_by_term.tsv", sep="\t", index=False)
perm
```

## β-NTI (Stegen framework, FastTree backbone)

We use the vectorised Python implementation in ``eq.bnti`` with 999
null permutations on the top-500 most prevalent ASVs per compartment.
Surface is near-neutral; deep and rhizosphere show variable selection
(mean β-NTI > 0, ~18 % of pairs |β-NTI| > 2).

```{python}
#| label: bnti
import json
bnti_dir = REPO / "cache" / "bnti"
panels = {}
summaries = []
for comp in ("surface", "deep", "rhizosphere"):
    f = bnti_dir / f"bNTI_{comp}.parquet"
    s = bnti_dir / f"summary_{comp}.json"
    if not f.exists():
        continue
    b = pd.read_parquet(f)
    panels[comp] = b.to_numpy()[np.triu_indices(b.shape[0], k=1)]
    summaries.append(json.loads(s.read_text()))

summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summaries).set_index("compartment")
summary_df[["n_samples", "n_pairs", "mean_bnti", "sd_bnti",
            "frac_variable_selection", "frac_homogeneous_selection",
            "frac_stochastic"]].round(3)
```

```{python}
#| label: fig2cd-bnti
palette = {"surface": "#d62728", "deep": "#1f77b4", "rhizosphere": "#2ca02c"}
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))

# Left: β-NTI histograms per compartment
for comp, vals in panels.items():
    v = vals[np.isfinite(vals)]
    ax1.hist(v, bins=80, alpha=0.45, label=f"{comp}", density=True,
             color=palette[comp])
ax1.axvline(-2, color="k", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8)
ax1.axvline(+2, color="k", linestyle="--", linewidth=0.8)
ax1.set_xlabel("β-NTI"); ax1.set_ylabel("density")
ax1.set_xlim(-6, 6)
ax1.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8)
ax1.set_title("Phylogenetic null-model decomposition")

# Right: process fractions (stacked)
rows = summary_df[["frac_homogeneous_selection", "frac_stochastic",
                    "frac_variable_selection"]]
rows.columns = ["homog. selection", "stochastic", "variable selection"]
rows.plot.bar(stacked=True, ax=ax2, color=["#4C72B0", "#CCCCCC", "#C44E52"],
              edgecolor="white", linewidth=0.4)
ax2.set_ylabel("fraction of sample pairs"); ax2.set_xlabel("")
ax2.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8, loc="lower right")
ax2.set_title("Assembly-process fractions (Stegen)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig(FIGURES_DIR / "fig2cd_bnti.pdf", bbox_inches="tight")
plt.show()

for comp, vals in panels.items():
    v = vals[np.isfinite(vals)]
    print(f"{comp:12s}  mean={v.mean():+.2f}  sd={v.std():.2f}  "
          f"|β-NTI|>2 = {(np.abs(v)>2).mean():.3f}  "
          f"(var-sel {(v>2).mean():.3f}, hom-sel {(v<-2).mean():.3f})")
```
